latestVersion.changelog:
Grand Slam Offer Creation skill v1.0.0 – initial release

- Provides a 5-step framework to design differentiated, high-value offers from scratch or rebuild existing ones facing commoditization or poor conversion.
- Guides users to define target customers’ dream outcomes, map obstacles, convert them into solution components, choose optimal delivery vehicles, and assemble stacked, high-perceived-value offers.
- Includes strategic advice to avoid business-destroying fulfillment burdens and emphasizes value-to-price gap for irresistible offers.
- Specifies when to use this skill, required context, and recommended follow-up skills for full offer construction.
- Applies to coaching, consulting, agencies, courses, SaaS, and any business where offer structure impacts price and sales.
